meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让代理切入高强度自主执行模式,按既定指令持续作业
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望代理在无人看护下持续高强度完成任务
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the agent to keep grinding on long tasks without supervision

howto.what: Claude 进入 ultrawork 模式:首行固定输出 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!,登记目标与成功标准,建 notepad 文件记录进展,用 todo 跟踪每一步,并驱动真实界面验证改动后才算完成。
howto.when: 当你要求开启 ultrawork 模式时触发;若同时带有 ulw-loop 指针或 ulw-execute 技能,则由其状态接管目标与笔记。

say.text: 开启 ultrawork 模式,修掉这个 bug 并用真实请求验证
say.note: 首行会输出 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式给这个新接口写实现并跑通请求
say.note: 会先登记目标与成功标准再动手

say.text: 以 ultrawork 模式重构这块代码,每步都留下验证证据
say.note: 过程写入 notepad,todo 逐步勾掉

howto.what_en: Claude enters ultrawork mode: its first line is exactly ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!, it registers a goal with success criteria, keeps a notepad file, tracks steps with todos, and proves each change by driving the real surface.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for ultrawork mode; if a ulw-loop pointer or the ulw-execute skill comes with the directive, its state owns the goal and the notepad.

say_en.text: Enable ultrawork mode and fix this bug, proving it with a real request.
Use ultrawork mode to implement this new endpoint and run a real request.
say_en.note: Registers the goal and criteria first.

say_en.text: Refactor this code in ultrawork mode, leaving evidence at each step.
say_en.note: Progress goes to the notepad and todos.
